A '''JPP-192 limospeeder''',<ref name="Dawn" /> also known as a '''Senate limo''',<ref name="TAF">{{Andor|The Axe Forgets}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> was a type of [[Limousine|limospeeder]] used by [[Mon Mothma]] during her time as a [[Senator]] in the [[Imperial Senate]], during which time it was driven by personal driver [[Exmar Kloris]].<ref name="Dawn" />
